summary: Opened a second, independent sourced question on the same recovery mechanism: the RestoreCommittedLogs startup replay delivers FSM batches through a 128-slot channel whose only consumer (runFSM) NewRaft starts after the replay returns, so a replay needing more than 128 batches of MaxAppendEntries blocks inside NewRaft with no timeout and no reachable shutdown. Added 5 sources (processLogs batching at raft.go:1296-1364, the channel at api.go:560, the goroutine start at api.go:636-638, default config at config.go:331-342, shouldSnapshot at snapshot.go:107-121), 3 behaviors, a source-only interpretation asserting the defect, and one fixed experiment in draft/assurance_generated_test.go that restarts ~9000-entry prefixes with the flag on and off and compares whether NewRaft returns within 8000ms, reporting a stack sample of the blocked goroutine. Retained receipt still pending; the proportional MaxAppendEntries relation and multi-node member loss remain unmeasured.
